Preliminary assessment: Norland’s Novaya River declaration contains an unresolved discrepancy—its functional description and accountable totals are unchanged despite observable on-site changes.  
Three independent indicators underpin this concern: (1) recent high‑resolution imagery shows newly completed construction footprints inside the declared perimeter inconsistent with simple storage/maintenance upgrades; (2) SAR/commercial radar and time‑series products show a sustained uptick in rail traffic servicing Novaya River over the last quarter; and (3) open‑source logistics reports corroborate elevated freight movements to the site.  
This situation meets the threshold for an "issue requiring clarification" (not yet a formal finding of non‑compliance), because plausible benign explanations remain possible but unverified.  
Recommended immediate action: issue a formal Section III clarification request giving Norland 10 working days to provide updated as‑built schematics and facility functional descriptions, construction contracts/work orders and completion certificates, updated accountable‑item inventories and dismantlement logs, rail movement manifests/shipping records for the past six months, and relevant personnel/maintenance rosters.  
Simultaneously begin planning a short‑notice on‑site inspection (inventory verification, records review, and targeted measurements/imagery comparison) to be mobilized within ~30 calendar days if Norland’s documentation is incomplete or inconsistent.
